articles.title: Jensen Huang's return sends Nvidia and Asian stocks soaring | BBC News
articles.titleZh: Jensen Huang的回归令Nvidia和亚洲股市飙升 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Asian markets are surging, with chipmakers leading gains across the region, after Nvidia reinstated co-founder Jensen Huang as chief executive - reuniting enthusiasm for AI trade.
 
South Korea's Kospi index is up by more than 6.8% while Japan's Nikkei 225 has jumped by 3.8%, as of around noon in East Asia.
 
Both benchmarks are deeply linked to the tech industry and have been driven by jumps in the shares of big names like SK Hynix, which is up by 8.5%.
 
US President Donald Trump said he "made the deal" for Huang's reinstatement, adding he had spoken to Nvidia's board both "directly and indirectly" about the co-founder.

articles.readingTextZh:
在英伟达重新任命联合创始人黄仁勋担任首席执行官，重燃人工智能交易热情之后，亚洲市场正在飙升，其中芯片制造商领涨整个地区。

截至东亚午间时分，韩国的科斯达克指数上涨超过6.8%，而日本的日经225指数上涨3.8%。

这两个基准指数都与科技行业有着密切的联系，并受到SK海力士等知名公司股价飙升的推动，该公司的股价上涨了8.5%。

美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，他“促成了”黄仁勋的复职，并补充说，他曾“直接和间接”地与英伟达董事会谈及这位联合创始人。

articles.title: Trump says he personally pressed for Huang's return to Nvidia | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 特朗普称他亲自施压要求黄仁勋返回英伟达 | BBC新闻
articles.summary:
Nvidia has reinstated CEO Jensen Huang just days after rejecting his offer to return to the AI chipmaker - and less than two weeks after he was forced to resign over reports of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
 
The company had come under pressure from US President Donald Trump to reappoint Huang - and on Monday, the president said he "made the deal" to "convince" the tech giant's board to reverse course and bring Huang back.
 
Since returning last year to the White House, Trump has amassed a significant level of investment in Nvidia. Recent financial disclosures show he purchased $265,000 in its stock and sold as much as $15,000 worth of shares in September.
 
A BBC review of his government financial disclosures for the last two years shows he purchased shares of Nvidia stock worth between $23m and $86m (£18m and £66m). And he has bought Nvidia stock 85 separate times through a number of investment accounts.
 
Both Trump and White House have repeatedly rejected assertions that he has profited from the presidency.

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.readingText:
Nvidia has reinstated CEO Jensen Huang just days after rejecting his offer to return to the AI chipmaker - and less than two weeks after he was forced to resign over reports of an affair with a suspected Chinese spy.

The company had come under pressure from US President Donald Trump to reappoint Huang - and on Monday, the president said he "made the deal" to "convince" the tech giant's board to reverse course and bring Huang back.

Since returning last year to the White House, Trump has amassed a significant level of investment in Nvidia.

Recent financial disclosures show he purchased $265,000 in its stock and sold as much as $15,000 worth of shares in September.

A BBC review of his government financial disclosures for the last two years shows he purchased shares of Nvidia stock worth between $23m and $86m (£18m and £66m).

And he has bought Nvidia stock 85 separate times through a number of investment accounts.

Both Trump and White House have repeatedly rejected assertions that he has profited from the presidency.

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news
articles.readingTextZh:
在拒绝黄仁勋重返人工智能芯片制造商的提议仅数日后，以及在因涉嫌与中国间谍有染的报道而被迫辞职不到两周后，英伟达（Nvidia）重新任命黄仁勋为首席执行官。

该公司曾受到美国总统唐纳德·特朗普的施压，要求其重新任命黄先生。周一，总统表示他“达成了协议”，以“说服”这家科技巨头的董事会改变主意，让黄先生回归。

自去年重返白宫以来，特朗普在英伟达的投资规模已相当可观。

最近的财务披露显示，他购买了价值 26.5 万美元的该公司股票，并在 9 月份出售了价值高达 1.5 万美元的股票。

英国广播公司（BBC）对其政府过去两年的财务披露进行的审查显示，他购买了价值2300万美元至8600万美元（1800万英镑至6600万英镑）的英伟达股票。

他通过多个投资账户分85次购买了英伟达的股票。

特朗普和白宫都曾多次否认他从总统任期中获益的说法。

如需了解最新资讯，请下载BBC News应用程序或访问BBC.com/news

articles.title: Iran says it won't tolerate US blockade and sanctions | BBC News
articles.titleZh: 伊朗表示不会容忍美国的封锁和制裁 | BBC 新闻
articles.summary:
Iran vows to use 'all available means' to counter the US blockade after President Trump said Iranian ships trying to break it would go "to the bottom of the sea".
 
Meanwhile, Iranian State TV shows footage of what it says is a new missile launcher.
 
And a British endurance swimmer has completed a three-day swim through the Strait of Hormuz to draw attention to the environmental cost of the conflict involving Iran.

Subscribe to our channel here: https://bbc.in/bbcnews

For the latest news download the BBC News app or visit BBC.com/news

articles.title: OpenAI insider: An AI accident is the most likely way people will die
articles.titleZh: OpenAI内部人士：人工智能事故是最可能导致人类死亡的方式
articles.summary:
OpenAI Board Member Paul Christiano details a warning: within the next one to three years, there is a high risk of an artificial intelligence takeover that could lead to catastrophic global consequences.

Christiano explains how modern training methods incentivize AI systems to bypass human evaluation, cheat to obtain high scores, and actively resist human control—a behavior already observed in miniature during the recent Hugging Face security incident.

0:00 The prediction of AI accident risks
3:14 The alignment problem: How AI learns to cheat
10:56 Can we trust AI companies to regulate themselves?
14:03 What about the US-China AI arms race?
19:01 Do we really know what these AI models are doing?

Watch 24/7 live news with CNN Headlines: https://bit.ly/4eIvlTr

Stream more on CNN with an All Access subscription: https://cnn.it/4AZMu54

#AI #Technology #News

OpenAI Board Member Paul Christiano details a warning: within the next one to three years, there is a high risk of an artificial intelligence takeover that could lead to catastrophic global consequences.

articles.readingTextZh:
OpenAI董事会成员保罗·克里斯蒂亚诺（Paul Christiano）详细阐述了一项警告：在未来一至三年内，人工智能接管的风险很高，这可能导致灾难性的全球后果。

克里斯蒂亚诺解释了现代训练方法如何激励人工智能系统绕过人类评估、作弊以获得高分，以及积极抵制人类控制——这种行为在最近的 Hugging Face 安全事件中已经小规模地出现过。
